source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Introduction to Computer Networks' (PDF 6-7): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Computer network mukhtalif devices ko aapas mein jurne aur baat karne deta hai. Is se maloomat jaldi aur aasani se share hoti hain. Network ke zariye baat-cheet waqt aur mehnat bachati hai. Computer networks gharon, schools, offices aur businesses mein istemal hote hain. Aaj ki zindagi rozana ke kaamon ke liye computer networks par bohat dependent (yani in ke baghair kaam nahi chalta) hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein Wi-Fi lehron wala wireless router, jo tooti lakeeron (dashed lines) se desktop computer, laptop, monitor, printer, mobile phone, folder, cloud, music aur video ke nishan se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: Computer network mukhtalif devices ko data aur wasail (resources) share karne ke liye jorta hai (kitab ki Figure 1.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Networks computers, mobile phones, printers aur doosre digital devices ko jor sakte hain (jaise Figure 1.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai). Yeh devices cables (taaron) ya wireless signals (baghair taar ke signals) se baat karte hain. Network data, files aur resources (share hone wali cheezein, jaise printer ya internet) ko ek device se doosre device tak jane deta hai. Zaroorat ke mutabiq network chhota ya bara ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 1.1 ke beech mein wireless router hai. Computer, laptop, mobile aur printer sab isi se jure hain, is liye woh files, gaane, videos aur cloud ka data aapas mein share kar sakte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Networks online parhai aur remote work (ghar se kaam) mein madad dete hain. Businesses apne rozana ke kaamon ke liye networks par bharosa karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Computer network kya karta hai, aur devices aapas mein kis cheez ke zariye baat karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Computer network devices ko jorta hai taake woh baat kar sakein aur data, files aur resources share kar sakein. Devices cables ya wireless signals se baat karte hain.

items: Network devices ko jor kar data, files aur resources share karata hai; waqt aur mehnat bachata hai.
Devices cables ya wireless signals se baat karte hain; network chhota ya bara ho sakta hai.
